lines.text: Time to get better at cooking!
I want to level up my cooking.

data.define: To grow in skill, like moving up in a game.

example.text: I want to level up my cooking.

misuse.text: Don't tell your teacher to 'level up'.
misuse.why: It sounds like a challenge, not respect.

hook.text: Time to get better at cooking!

publish.title: What does "level up" mean?
publish.value: Level up = Improve and get better. Example: "I want to level up my cooking." (casual English).
